integrity: All algebraic assertions are proved symbolically; finite-field checker corroborates small instances only. Historical novelty is qualified and independent assessment remains necessary.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to ordinary finite-field Heisenberg Lie algebras and linear local automorphisms; no claim for arbitrary nilpotent Lie algebras or nonlinear two-local maps. The 2024/2025 Sheng-Liu-Miao primary full text was inaccessible and could contain an equivalent finite-field implication.
title: The unique finite-field rigidity point for local automorphisms of Heisenberg Lie algebras
